findings.summary: Each populated table creates nested named region landmarks for the same content, adding redundant stops to screen-reader landmark navigation.
findings.fix: Keep the table heading and section, but remove the parent section’s aria-labelledby so it remains a semantic grouping; retain the named, focusable scroll region.

passed: Student navigation marks the active link with aria-current="page".
The sidebar navigation, main content, page header, and footer use appropriate landmark semantics and names.
Table regions have accessible names; tables use captions and column headers with scope="col".
ARIA references in the reviewed templates point to existing IDs.
notes: The Menu button has aria-expanded="false" and aria-controls references the sidebar; runtime state updates are outside the requested file scope.
